content.text: {"affected_statement":"L6.2","objection_correct":"yes","established_elsewhere":"no","elsewhere_quote":null,"status_as_written":"not_established","repair_distance":"lemma","explanation":"The asserted unbounded infinite-sunflower fact is false; the nested-chain counterexample is valid, and the proposed induction is well-founded only under a uniform size bound. The later finiteness of terminal members—and hence of P and C—depends on Lemma 1’s bounded-size conclusion, but that conclusion is merely deduced from the invalid stronger lemma, not separately proved. Repair requires restating Lemma 1 for transversals of size at most K and giving induction on K (after restricting to a fixed cardinality), so this is a lemma-level repair."}
